workers.name: OPENER
workers.inspired_by: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz (2024): 5-minute ORB on Stocks in Play
workers.method: At 9:35 ET ranks the watchlist by opening volume vs its last 14 days and keeps the top 20 'stocks in play'. If the first 5-minute candle was green it buys a break of that candle's high; if red it shorts a break of the low. Stop is 10% of the 14-day ATR. No target: it holds to the close.

workers.name: MOMENTUM
workers.inspired_by: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024): intraday momentum on SPY
workers.method: Builds a 'noise area' around today's open from SPY's average move at each minute over the last 14 days. Every :00 and :30 from 10:00 ET it buys if price is above the area or shorts if below. Trailing exit at the area edge or VWAP, all closed by the end of the day. Size targets 2% daily volatility.

workers.name: ORB
workers.method: Marks the high and low of the first 15 minutes, then trades the first clean break of that range, before 11:30 ET.

workers.name: VWAP
workers.inspired_by: the VWAP reclaim used by institutional desks
workers.method: After 10:00 ET, buys when price crosses back above VWAP with the trend pointing up, sells short on the mirror image.

workers.name: TREND
workers.inspired_by: the 9/21 EMA pullback popular with momentum day traders
workers.method: When the 9 EMA is above the 21 EMA, waits for price to dip to the 9 and bounce, then buys. Mirror for shorts.

workers.name: SNAPBACK
workers.method: In an uptrend (price above the 50 EMA), buys sharp short-term drops when RSI(2) falls under 5, aiming for a quick snap back.

workers.name: SWEEP
workers.inspired_by: the liquidity-sweep and fair value gap model (ICT / smart money)
workers.method: Waits for price to run past a level where stops sit (prior day high/low, opening range), snap back, and leave a fair value gap in the other direction. Enters on the retrace into the gap, stop past the sweep, only with the 15m/60m trend, and only 9:45-11:30 or 1:30-3:00 ET.

workers.name: TURTLE
workers.method: Crypto, around the clock. Buys a break of the last 60-minute high, stop 2 ATR below, target 4 ATR above. Long only.
workers.thought: Channel 78093.10 to 78405.75. Waiting for a break.
